svg.text: DESCENT (A194): the corner-hurt region, a descent kill on a real witness, and one grain move
docs/proofs/descent.md — Lemma CH, Theorems D1–D3; descent_grains.md; descent_examples.md. Every drawn configuration is containment- and overlap-checked.
(1) CORNER HURT — Trump's TL corner in its corner frame (Lemma CH)
grey stipple = LONELY centres at tilt 49.8° (Theorem B: no second meeter of the widened box exists); green = non-lonely
cyan = Trump's meeters sq6 / sq4 at depths d1 = 0.194, d2 = 0.181; hatched = the sealed box (0, c_b - d1)^2, area 0.692; dashed box = after the d2-conversion
cells at c_b = 1 + w (Lemma A2: one centre per cell)
(2) DESCENT KILL — A163 trump5 witness 053 (9 squares, side 3.8739 < s0, TL(0,0) dropped), dilated to s0
f1 (red) is the ONLY square meeting the widened TL box and its pose is LONELY (Theorem B, margin -0.13):
a trump5 packing must meet TL(0,0) twice (k6_23 dead on the window, Theorem FC) — Theorem D2(b) kills the witness by a clip, no tree
f1 depth at the widened TL box: 0.219; partner search 0 of 200,000 draws; the same holds on all nine A163 witnesses (descent_examples.md §7.2)
(3) ONE GRAIN MOVE — the pinwheel 4-grain (S02) at s* = 3.886746, common tilt 48.4351°
f0 is a strut: its exact freedom is a SLIDE of length 0.298 at fixed tilt (orange segment; rails BL(1,0)/f3, stops BR(0,1)/f1) — no slot at either end
the load path f1 f2 f3 BL(0,1) BR(0,1) moves by the common tilt: s*(θ) = 3.997 / 3.911 / 3.887 / 3.902 / 3.974 at 3.4° / 28.4° / 48.4° / 68.4° / 88.4° — above s0 everywhere

amber = the load path (the grain); blue = the slots it leans on; dashed = s0. Kills are constant along moves inside a certified box (descent_grains.md §6.2); the move is the coordinate, not the mechanism.
